features.notes: CSS and the platform Tailwind pipeline work; arbitrary user-supplied Vite plugins are not a compatibility promise.
Tuto intentionally recompiles request revisions with esbuild; it does not run a per-student Vite watcher or HMR server.
The platform target is Tuto's Node 22 request host, not Netlify, Cloudflare, Bun, or Deno adapter parity.
The agreed design runs compiled revisions in bounded reusable Node workers; it does not create a container or microVM per preview.
